correctness.rationale: Differentiating F(s)=exp((1-r)(F(s)-1)+r(s-1)) at one yields mean mutant-family size 1 and variance 1/r, with higher moments finite from the subcritical Poisson clone family. The symmetric three-type transition matrix has Perron mode 1 and contrast eigenvalue -1/2. The critical size-Doob transform h(N)=S gives exact E^up[D_next|N]=-(1+v/S)D/2 and conditional innovation variance [(v+1)(N1+N2)/4+N3]+O_r(1). Contraction of both non-Perron contrasts yields O(n) second moments and type fractions 1/3, while the total critical Q chain has S_n/n -> Gamma(2,v/2). For a fixed window the size-biased spine changes only O(1) variance, the conditional Lindeberg theorem gives innovations sqrt(W)N(0,(v+3)/6), and geometric forgetting of the remote past gives AR(-1/2); studentization cancels the same W and yields independence. The argument does not extrapolate finite rational checks to infinite n.
